items.definition:
without power or ability
She felt powerless to change the situation.

shining brightly; glowing
Her smile was radiant as she accepted the award.

without conditions or limitations
She offered him her unconditional support.

deserving respect and approval
Her dedication to the cause is truly admirable.

having a charming and inspiring personality
The charismatic leader inspired his followers.

mutually opposed or inconsistent
His statements were contradictory, making it hard to believe him.

relating to the front
The car sustained frontal damage in the accident.

uncontrollably emotional
The audience became hysterical with laughter.

not able to exist or be used together
Their personalities were completely incompatible.

inspiring enthusiasm or desire to do something
His speech was very motivational.

not natural or normal
The silence in the forest felt unnatural.

impossible to stop or prevent
The team was unstoppable, winning every game.

too attractive and tempting to be resisted
The offer was so good it was irresistible.

denoting events or phenomena that are beyond the scope of normal scientific understanding
She is interested in paranormal activities like ghosts and UFOs.

fashionable
That new cafe is very trendy.

impossible to endure
The heat was almost unbearable.

not old enough
It's illegal to sell alcohol to underage people.

giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words
Please write a concise summary of the report.

relating to the process of digesting food
The digestive system breaks down food.

causing or tending to cause disruption
His disruptive behavior led to his expulsion.

relating to or denoting graphs or diagrams
The software has a user-friendly graphical interface.

not conforming to accepted standards of morality
His actions were considered deeply immoral by the community.

not achieving maximum productivity; wasting time or resources
The old system was very inefficient and wasted a lot of time.

strong, healthy, and full of energy
He took a vigorous walk every morning.

able to be heard
Her whisper was barely audible across the room.

truthful and straightforward
She gave a candid assessment of the situation, without holding back.

relating to the back of an animal or plant
The shark's dorsal fin was visible above the water.

relating to the organs of reproduction
The doctor examined the patient's genital area.

ugly or disgusting to look at
The monster in the movie had a hideous face.

having or showing creativity or inventiveness
The author is known for her imaginative storytelling.

showing or feeling no concern for others' feelings; not responsive to stimuli
His insensitive comments hurt her feelings.

relating to the Protestant Church founded by Martin Luther
My grandparents belong to the Lutheran church.

feeling or evoking a sense of nostalgia
Looking at old photos made her feel nostalgic.

unjustly inflicting hardship and constraint
The oppressive heat made it difficult to work.

arranged in rays or radiating from a central point
The car has radial tires for better grip.

able to be recognized or identified
His voice was instantly recognizable.

Somewhat fat or strongly built
He was a stout man with a friendly face.

Anxious or uncomfortable
She felt uneasy about the silence.

auxiliary
Plug the cable into the aux port.

relating to a broad group of people indigenous to Europe, North Africa, the Horn of Africa, West Asia, Central Asia, and South Asia
The study included participants of various ethnic backgrounds, including Caucasian.

silly; foolish
Don't be daft, that's a ridiculous idea!

lasting forever or for a very long time
They promised each other everlasting love.

having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned
She was indifferent to their pleas.

existing only in ancient myths; imaginary
Dragons are mythical creatures.

Serving to prepare for something
She attended a preparatory school before university.

Relating to a section or division of something
We bought a new sectional sofa for the living room.

Able to be dissolved, especially in water
Sugar is soluble in water.

able to pay debts; able to dissolve other substances
The company remained solvent despite the economic downturn.

not officially recorded or proved
The historian found several undocumented facts about the event.

relating to or inherited from an ancestor
They visited their ancestral home in the village.

relating to or affected by autism
The school provides support for autistic students.

not hopeful or encouraging; dreary
The future looked bleak after the company closed.

not genuine or true; fake
He tried to pay with a bogus twenty-dollar bill.

relating to or constituting a contract
They have a contractual obligation to finish the work by Friday.

relating to the punishment and rehabilitation of criminals
He was sent to a correctional facility.

careful and circumspect in one's speech or actions
He made a few discreet inquiries about the job.

showing feelings clearly
Her face was very expressive, showing all her emotions.

extremely unpleasant or dreadful
The weather conditions were horrendous during the storm.

not firm or stiff; walking with difficulty
After the injury, his arm felt limp and useless.

expressing deep emotion or a beautiful, imaginative quality
Her lyrical poetry moved everyone in the audience.

occurring through divine or supernatural intervention, or a highly improbable and welcome event
It was a miraculous recovery after the accident.

lacking interest or excitement; dull
He found his daily routine to be quite mundane.

relating to or characterized by obsession
He has an obsessive need for cleanliness.

(of a woman) attractively small and dainty
The petite dancer moved gracefully across the stage.
